title: Happy Friday Fam - Weekend Self-Care
excerpt: You made it through another week. Time to celebrate and recharge.
content:
Happy Friday Fam!

You made it. Another week in the books, and you are still standing. That alone is worth celebrating.

As we head into the weekend, I want to share some of my favorite self-care rituals that keep me grounded and grateful.

My Weekend Self-Care Checklist

  • Cook something that makes you happy. For me, that is always something from home. A pot of ndole, some plantains, or my famous soya. Food is love, and cooking is therapy.
  • Move your body. It does not have to be a full workout. A walk around the block, some stretching, dancing in your kitchen - whatever makes you feel alive.
  • Connect with someone you love. Call your mama. Text your friend. Sit with your family. We are not meant to do life alone.
  • Rest without guilt. You are not lazy for resting. You are human. Your body and mind need time to recharge.
  • Do something creative. Bake something new, try a recipe, write in your journal, take some photos. Create for the joy of it.

This weekend, I am trying a new cake recipe that I cannot wait to share with you all. Stay tuned!

What are your weekend plans? Drop them below!
